notes.title: Update CM 4050
notes.notes:
Added new levels, all available levels in game 10.
To pass you need to collect coins and pass the difficult tests.

notes.title: Update CM 2830-F14
notes.notes:
Support for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Hindi, French and German has been added to the interface.

Improved game levels, added additional obstacles. In secret places you can find extra lives and collect coins.
In the next levels, Coins will play an important role and allow you to pass levels in different ways.

notes.title: Update CM 2529
notes.notes:
Improved animation.
 Added dynamic soundtrack.
 Improved game levels.
